bounded_types.1: Bool Tensor with one-byte elements: documented typed/logical/reduction paths
bounded_types.2: signed int64 Tensor with eight-byte elements: documented typed/integer/mixed/reduction paths; native wrapping negation in admitted no-grad layouts Native no-grad ReLU is implemented for the admitted layouts.
bounded_types.3: internal rank-zero wrapped IEEE binary64 Scalar only; no general F64 Tensor service
bounded_types.4: Public binary64 selected storage/conversion/logical paths, predicates, exact-bit negation and no-grad mixed F64 with F32/Bool/I64 add/sub/mul/true-div on admitted rank0..4 layouts. Direct I64-to-F64 uses nearest-even integer conversion without an intermediate F32. Direct requires_grad/as_strided, general F64 Tensor parity and complete architecture support remain open. Same-F64 arithmetic and ReLU have finite exact-bit AVX2 gates, which must execute on this current image.
bounded_types.5: Public F16 storage/copy/fill, selected F32 conversion, dense no-grad logical operations, numeric predicates and tested tensor addition/subtraction (alpha=1), multiplication, true division, negation and ReLU. Arithmetic uses an explicit AVX2 fixed-wheel Torch oracle. Other arithmetic forms, architectures and Half AD remain open.
bounded_types.6: Public BF16 storage/copy/fill, selected F32 conversions, dense no-grad logical operations, numeric predicates and tested tensor addition/subtraction (alpha=1), multiplication, true division, negation and ReLU. Copy follows fixed AVX2/AVX512 layouts; arithmetic uses an explicit AVX2 fixed-wheel Torch oracle. DEFAULT, other architectures, other arithmetic forms and Half AD remain open.

2.name: Half and public F64 tensor arithmetic
2.scope: At least one public F16/BF16 Tensor operand, admitted no-grad public dtype promotion and layouts. Exact actual AVX2 Torch bytes, geometry, independent ownership and unchanged inputs are mandatory. Bool subtraction remains an actual Torch error; private dtype3 retains its protocol boundary. True division retains the original RHS F32 opmath value for reduced floating results when TensorIterator treats the RHS as scalar. No floor/trunc rounding_mode, out/inplace or Half AD is added. Mixed pairs (4,0/1/2) in either order also use rank-aware promotion and fresh owned results; Bool subtraction remains refused. Same public F64 pairs now use these native kernels for selectors1..4. The5088-case reference checks exact AVX2 scalar/vector NaN payloads, including singleton rank and stride ordering. Full dtype, architecture and AD parity remains open. Original command2 words4..7 remain ignored; they do not implement alpha or rounding_mode.

3.name: Half, I64 and public F64 unary kernels
3.scope: Public F16/BF16/I64/F64 no-grad tensors in admitted rank0..4 layouts. Both operations require exact fresh fixed-wheel Torch bytes, geometry, independent ownership and unchanged inputs. Negation preserves its wrapping/sign-bit semantics. ReLU preserves negative zero; F64 NaN payloads remain unchanged, while reduced-float32-element vector chunks reproduce fixed AVX2 quieting/canonicalization and scalar tails retain the observed payloads. Bool ReLU is refused. Other typed unary operations and Half/F64 AD remain open.
